title: Brazilian Cheese Frittata
description: A delicious Brazilian-inspired omelette filled with cheese, perfect for breakfast or brunch. This frittata is easy to make and packed with flavor.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, salt, and black pepper.
Add shredded cheese, crumbled Brazilian cheese, and whisk until combined.
Pour egg mixture into a greased 9-inch pie plate or skillet.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the edges are golden brown and the center is set.
Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Use a spatula to loosen the frittata from the pan and slide onto a plate.
Serve hot, garnished with additional cheese if desired.
